newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end weaker, eye on political picture.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end weaker, eye on political picture.

text.p: Shares in Tokyo extended losses to close weaker on Wednesday, as most investors held back from buying, with the unclear political situation amid upcoming general elections casting a pall over the market, brokers said.
The market will be closed on Thursday for a holiday.
The key 225-share Nikkei average lost 167.70 points, or 0.80 percent, to finish at 20,870.83. Its December futures shed 120 points to 20,910.
"Until we can paint a clearer picture of a new government, we won't be able to move much," said Tadahiro Kamogawa, senior analyst at Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd.
